SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_image , cc.child_category_name, sp.store_price, sp.store_stock FROM store_products sp
INNER JOIN products p ON sp.product_id = p.id
INNER JOIN child_categories cc ON p.child_category_id = cc.id
WHERE sp.store_id = #{storeId}
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id, p.product_image, p.product_name, p.product_explanation, p.purchase_cost, p.maker_price, mc.main_category_name, sc.sub_category_name, cc.child_category_name, sp.store_price, sp.store_stock,m.maker_name
FROM products p
INNER JOIN child_categories cc ON p.child_category_id = cc.id
INNER JOIN sub_categories sc ON cc.sub_category_id = sc.id
INNER JOIN main_categories mc ON sc.main_category_id = mc.id
INNER JOIN store_products sp ON sp.product_id = p.id
INNER JOIN maker m ON p.maker_id = m.id
WHERE sp.store_id = #{storeId} AND sp.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_histories (admin_id, store_id, product_id, order_number, sum_price) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{storeId}, #{productId}, #{orderNumber}, #{sumPrice})
mapper.select:
SELECT p.product_name, p.product_image,a.last_name,a.first_name, oh.id, oh.order_number, oh.sum_price,oh.created_at, oh.sum_price DIV oh.order_number AS purchaseCost
FROM products p
INNER JOIN order_histories oh ON p.id = oh.product_id
INNER JOIN admins a ON a.id = oh.admin_id
WHERE oh.store_id = #{storeId}
ORDER BY oh.created_at DESC
